Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Gerardo Parra?

Gerardo Parra is 39 years old.

When was Gerardo Parra born?

Gerardo Parra was born on May 6, 1987.

Where was Gerardo Parra born?

Gerardo Parra was born in Santa Barbara, Venezuela.

How tall is Gerardo Parra?

Gerardo Parra is 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much did Gerardo Parra weigh when playing?

Gerardo Parra weighed 209 lbs (94 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Gerardo Parra play?

Gerardo Parra played 12 seasons.

Is Gerardo Parra in the Hall of Fame?

Gerardo Parra has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Gerardo Parra play?

Gerardo Parra was an Outfielder.

How many hits did Gerardo Parra have?

Gerardo Parra had 1,335 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Gerardo Parra have?

Gerardo Parra had 90 home runs over his career.

What was Gerardo Parra's average?

Gerardo Parra had a .275 average over his career.

How many teams has Gerardo Parra played for?

Gerardo Parra played for 6 teams; the Arizona Diamondbacks, Baltimore Orioles, Colorado Rockies, Milwaukee Brewers, San Francisco Giants and Washington Nationals.

How many World Series has Gerardo Parra won?

Gerardo Parra has won 1 World Series.

When did Gerardo Parra retire?

Gerardo Parra last played in 2021.

What are Gerardo Parra's nicknames?

Parra Shark, El Yolo are nicknames for Gerardo Parra.
